passages.title: Standard returns and gift returns
passages.text:
POL-RET-01 v1.1: Standard returns and gift returns
Conditions: Standard items may be returned within 30 calendar days of shipment.delivered_at, including day 30. Use the first recorded return request or dispatch date; a received return within that window also establishes timeliness. A standard refund requires a stored return.received_at and return.condition=like_new. An earlier return request remains valid on resume; do not restart its window.
Rules: For an eligible unreturned item, ask the customer to return the complete item in its original packaging through the store return process and retain tracking. The customer pays change-of-mind return shipping. Do not invent a warehouse address or claim to issue a return label. Use awaiting_customer while the necessary customer return action or order details are missing. If the customer has already completed their part and staff receipt verification is pending, escalate for staff review. After timely receipt in like-new condition, refund eligibility is established; exact approval and balance checks still apply under POL-RET-02. Gift recipients may return items for store credit within 30 days, including items marked final sale. Ownership or gift entitlement must be verified by staff. Issuing store credit is a staff action, not an agent tool.
Exceptions: Ordinary final-sale returns are excluded under POL-RET-04. The gift-return clause expressly includes final-sale items; if that policy disagrees, follow the conflict process in POL-SUP-01. For a change-of-mind request after day 30, explain that the return window has passed and escalate any exception request to Returns staff; do not decline it as final. Missing condition evidence also goes to Returns staff. A defect may have a separate damage or warranty path.

passages.title: Refund timing status and confirmation
passages.text:
POL-RET-03 v1.1: Refund timing status and confirmation
Conditions: Read refunds.refund_id, order_id, amount_cents, created_at, status, and the associated approval and customer ownership. An approval without a successful refund ledger record does not mean money was issued.
Rules: Issued refunds normally settle in 5 to 10 business days from created_at. Count the next Monday through Friday date as business day 1; weekends are excluded and holidays are not modeled. Refunds go to the original payment method. Do not redirect funds to a new account or person. State the recorded amount, issue date, and receipt ID when available. Status issued means issued, not received. Status settled means the ledger records settlement; a separate customer confirmation is required before closing the ticket. A refund-status inquiry can be resolved with a supported reply when no further service action is needed. A resolved ticket can become closed once the customer confirms receipt. Never refund again merely because the customer asks for an update.
Exceptions: If the customer reports nonreceipt after more than 10 business days, escalate to Returns staff for a ledger investigation. A missing receipt, inconsistent ledger, or failed message must not be described as successful completion.

passages.title: Damaged or incorrect items
passages.text:
POL-RET-05 v1.1: Damaged or incorrect items
Conditions: The report identifies an owned order and affected item. The delivery record is consistent with the report and the first report is within 30 calendar days of delivery. Staff approval for the specific damage or wrong-item remedy is required. A report alone is not permission to execute a refund.
Rules: Qualifying damaged or incorrect items are eligible for a refund or replacement after staff approval, including final-sale items. Customers do not pay return shipping for this remedy. When the order and report are consistent and only staff authorization for an exact refund remains, use awaiting_approval. Staff approval must record the damage or wrong-item basis; a generic approval unrelated to this claim is insufficient. The staff-approved remedy may waive a physical return. result.response: Thanks for reaching out. Here’s a quick rundown of our return window: standard items may be returned within 30 calendar days of shipment or delivery (the 30th day counts). Gift items may be returned within 30 days for store credit. To be eligible for a standard refund, the item must be received in like-new condition and in its original packaging. For change‑of‑mind returns, the customer covers return shipping. We do not issue a return label or provide a warehouse address; please start the return through the store return process. To check a specific order, please share the order_id and confirm your item type (standard vs gift) and, if possible, the delivery/shipment date so we can verify the 30‑day window. If you’re past 30 days, exceptions require staff review. If you suspect the item is damaged or incorrect, we can review that pathway as well.
